signals.translation: When cleaning, please support the earth's crust. Please use wet cotton to clean the sticker.

passages.english_span: Support the globe by its base while working.
passages.chinese_span: 清潔時請扶穩地球儀底座。
passages.translation: When cleaning, please support the earth's crust.

passages.english_span: Clean the raised labels with a dry cotton cloth.
passages.chinese_span: 請用濕棉布清潔凸字標籤。
passages.translation: Please use wet cotton to clean the sticker.

signals.translation: Donors must arrange for the piano to be sent to the community event room. The piano will be tuned when it arrives.

passages.english_span: The donor arranges delivery to the community room.
passages.chinese_span: 捐贈者須安排把鋼琴送至社區活動室。
passages.translation: Donors must arrange for the piano to be sent to the community event room.

passages.english_span: The piano will be tuned after it arrives.
passages.chinese_span: 鋼琴送抵後會安排調音。
passages.translation: The piano will be tuned when it arrives.

signals.translation: If a film is visible on the surface of the water, please note it in the field record book. Please use a sterile glass bottle with the sample set.

passages.english_span: Note any visible surface film in the field log.
passages.chinese_span: 如水面有可見薄膜,請在實地紀錄簿註明。
passages.translation: If a film is visible on the surface of the water, please note it in the field record book.

passages.english_span: Use the sterile glass bottle supplied with the sampling kit.
passages.chinese_span: 請使用採樣套件隨附的無菌玻璃瓶。
passages.translation: Please use a sterile glass bottle with the sample set.

signals.translation: Applicants are required to submit a brief self-introduction. Alumni instructors match students according to their areas of interest.

passages.english_span: Applicants submit a short introduction.
passages.chinese_span: 申請人須提交簡短自我介紹。
passages.translation: Applicants are required to submit a brief self-introduction.

passages.english_span: Mentors are matched to students by year group.
passages.chinese_span: 校友導師與學生按感興趣的領域配對。
passages.translation: Alumni instructors match students according to their areas of interest.

signals.translation: Temporary certificate holders are permitted to enter the exhibition space, except during live demonstrations. During the live demonstration, visitors can wait in the hall.

passages.english_span: The temporary badge allows access to the exhibition, except during a live demonstration.
passages.chinese_span: 臨時證持有人可進入展覽場地,但現場示範期間除外。
passages.translation: Temporary certificate holders are permitted to enter the exhibition space, except during live demonstrations.

passages.english_span: Visitors may wait in the foyer while a demonstration is running.
passages.chinese_span: 現場示範期間,訪客可在大堂等候。
passages.translation: During the live demonstration, visitors can wait in the hall.

signals.translation: The decision to suspend the license was sent by mail with the number of the hanger. Personnel will keep a copy of the license documentation.

passages.english_span: The suspension decision is served by registered post.
passages.chinese_span: 暫停許可證的決定以掛號郵件送達。
passages.translation: The decision to suspend the license was sent by mail with the number of the hanger.

passages.english_span: Officers retain a copy in the permit file.
passages.chinese_span: 人員會在許可證檔案內保留副本。
passages.translation: Personnel will keep a copy of the license documentation.

signals.translation: The name of the speaker is indicated, please refer to the program format instructions. Private contact information must be deleted before the draft can be read for comments. It is possible to add spelling corrections to shared documents.

passages.english_span: Please use the show's style sheet for speaker labels.
passages.chinese_span: 說話者的姓名標示請參照節目格式指引。
passages.translation: The name of the speaker is indicated, please refer to the program format instructions.

passages.english_span: Remove any private contact details from the draft before sending it around for comments.
passages.chinese_span: 傳閱草稿以徵詢意見前,須刪除當中的私人聯絡資料。
passages.translation: Private contact information must be deleted before the draft can be read for comments.

passages.english_span: Spelling corrections can be added in the shared document.
passages.chinese_span: 可在共用文件加入拼寫更正。
passages.translation: It is possible to add spelling corrections to shared documents.

signals.translation: If a unit fails to be inspected, other arrangements shall be made for the unit and the other units' reservations shall be maintained for the scheduled time. Please reserve enough space to make it easy for inspectors to contact the intersection. The group will provide the administrator with an updated list of visits.

passages.english_span: A missed inspection is rescheduled for the flat concerned, while appointments for other flats stand.
passages.chinese_span: 如有單位未能接受檢查,只須為該單位另作安排,其他單位的預約維持原定時間。
passages.translation: If a unit fails to be inspected, other arrangements shall be made for the unit and the other units' reservations shall be maintained for the scheduled time.

passages.english_span: Leave enough space for the inspector to reach the shutoff valve.
passages.chinese_span: 請預留足夠空間,方便檢查人員接觸截流閥。
passages.translation: Please reserve enough space to make it easy for inspectors to contact the intersection.

passages.english_span: The team will give the caretaker an updated visit list.
passages.chinese_span: 小組會向管理員提供更新後的到訪名單。
passages.translation: The group will provide the administrator with an updated list of visits.

signals.translation: Please indicate to the registry the language used in the translation. Translators must be at least 18 years old.

passages.english_span: Tell the registry which language will be used for interpretation.
passages.chinese_span: 請向登記處說明傳譯所用的語言。
passages.translation: Please indicate to the registry the language used in the translation.

passages.english_span: The interpreter must be at least 18 years old.
passages.chinese_span: 傳譯員須年滿18歲。
passages.translation: Translators must be at least 18 years old.

signals.translation: Foreign musicians may be exempted from school auditions if they have completed field trials, with the exception of those who have switched instruments. School rehearsals are arranged according to the show's seating schedule. The concert venue has an alternative soundtrack link.

passages.english_span: Visiting players may skip the school sound check if they completed the venue check, except when they have changed instruments in the meantime.
passages.chinese_span: 外來樂手如已完成場地試音,可豁免學校試音,但其間曾更換樂器者除外。
passages.translation: Foreign musicians may be exempted from school auditions if they have completed field trials, with the exception of those who have switched instruments.

passages.english_span: The school check uses the performance seating plan.
passages.chinese_span: 學校試音按演出座位表安排。
passages.translation: School rehearsals are arranged according to the show's seating schedule.

passages.english_span: There is a separate sound check at the performance venue.
passages.chinese_span: 演出場地另設試音環節。
passages.translation: The concert venue has an alternative soundtrack link.

signals.translation: The payment notice number is listed next to the account address. To enable the e-mail service, the validation code on the current payroll notice must be used.

passages.english_span: The demand number can be found next to the billing address.
passages.chinese_span: 繳款通知書編號列於帳單地址旁。
passages.translation: The payment notice number is listed next to the account address.

passages.english_span: Use the verification code printed on your current rates demand to activate digital correspondence.
passages.chinese_span: 啟用電子函件服務須使用本期差餉繳款通知書上的驗證碼。
passages.translation: To enable the e-mail service, the validation code on the current payroll notice must be used.

signals.translation: If the sample is torn, it must be recorded and re-printed; the finished sample is placed directly in the working document. Starting samples are also processed in the same way as tearing samples, except when the sample is outside the scope of the printed test. The same heating settings must be maintained when comparing samples. Please fill in the batch record sheet for the total number of samples received.

passages.english_span: A torn sample must be logged and rerun, while a clean sample goes straight into the job folder.
passages.chinese_span: 樣本如有撕裂,須記錄並重新試印;完好樣本則直接放入工作資料夾。
passages.translation: If the sample is torn, it must be recorded and re-printed; the finished sample is placed directly in the working document.

passages.english_span: Use the response assigned to a torn sample for a wrinkled sample as well, unless the wrinkle occurs beyond the printed test area.
passages.chinese_span: 起皺樣本亦按撕裂樣本的方式處理,但皺褶位於已印測試範圍之外則除外。
passages.translation: Starting samples are also processed in the same way as tearing samples, except when the sample is outside the scope of the printed test.

passages.english_span: Keep the same heat setting while comparing samples.
passages.chinese_span: 比較樣本時須維持相同的加熱設定。
passages.translation: The same heating settings must be maintained when comparing samples.

passages.english_span: Record the total number of accepted samples on the batch sheet.
passages.chinese_span: 請在批次紀錄表填上獲接納的樣本總數。
passages.translation: Please fill in the batch record sheet for the total number of samples received.

signals.translation: Accompanied persons can only use reserved seats on the quiet floor when the accompanying reader is present. Please call me when you leave the quiet floor. On a flat map, the location of the reservation desk is marked.

passages.english_span: A companion may use a reserved quiet-floor seat only when the reader they accompany is present.
passages.chinese_span: 陪同者只可在所陪同的讀者在場時,使用安靜樓層的預留座位。
passages.translation: Accompanied persons can only use reserved seats on the quiet floor when the accompanying reader is present.

passages.english_span: Please keep phone conversations outside the quiet floor.
passages.chinese_span: 請離開安靜樓層後才通電話。
passages.translation: Please call me when you leave the quiet floor.

passages.english_span: A map identifies the reserved desks.
passages.chinese_span: 平面圖上標有預留書桌的位置。
passages.translation: On a flat map, the location of the reservation desk is marked.

warnings.chinese_span: 故事分享小組會向小組成員分享錄音及經編輯的文字稿。
warnings.machine_backtranslation: The story-sharing group will share recorded and edited texts with the group members.

signals.translation: The volunteers reserve a list of shared content they have received. We will notify you when the text is ready. The story-sharing group will share recorded and edited texts with the group members.

passages.english_span: A volunteer keeps a list of the contributions received.
passages.chinese_span: 義工會備存已收到的分享內容清單。
passages.translation: The volunteers reserve a list of shared content they have received.

passages.english_span: We will send a separate message when the transcript is ready.
passages.chinese_span: 文字稿備妥後我們會另行通知。
passages.translation: We will notify you when the text is ready.

passages.english_span: The circle keeps the audio for internal transcription only and shares edited text with the group.
passages.chinese_span: 故事分享小組會向小組成員分享錄音及經編輯的文字稿。
passages.translation: The story-sharing group will share recorded and edited texts with the group members.

signals.translation: For the first time, you will need to pay a fee to apply for a checkup. Please state the blockage in the application form.

passages.english_span: There is no fee for requesting an initial drainage inspection.
passages.chinese_span: 首次申請渠務檢查毋須繳費。
passages.translation: For the first time, you will need to pay a fee to apply for a checkup.

passages.english_span: Provide a description of the blockage on the request form.
passages.chinese_span: 請在申請表說明淤塞情況。
passages.translation: Please state the blockage in the application form.

signals.translation: The map marker may be changed if confirmed by the site manager or one of the original providers. The update table requires a summary of the proposed changes. Please copy the existing map tag tags in the message.

passages.english_span: We accept a pin change only if both the venue manager and the original contributor confirm it.
passages.chinese_span: 地圖標記如獲場地經理或原提供資料者其中一方確認,便可更改。
passages.translation: The map marker may be changed if confirmed by the site manager or one of the original providers.

passages.english_span: The update form asks for a brief description of the proposed change.
passages.chinese_span: 更新表要求簡述擬作的改動。
passages.translation: The update table requires a summary of the proposed changes.

passages.english_span: Please copy the current pin label into your message.
passages.chinese_span: 請在訊息內抄錄現有地圖標記的標籤。
passages.translation: Please copy the existing map tag tags in the message.

signals.translation: The road signs were removed by the train operators and the temporary road markings were removed by the transportation team. The organisers of the festival will keep a copy of the closure notice.

passages.english_span: The tram operator removes the diversion signs, and the traffic team removes the temporary road markings.
passages.chinese_span: 改道指示牌由電車營辦商拆除,臨時路面標記則由交通小組清除。
passages.translation: The road signs were removed by the train operators and the temporary road markings were removed by the transportation team.

passages.english_span: The festival organiser keeps a copy of the closure notice.
passages.chinese_span: 節慶活動主辦機構會保存封路通知副本。
passages.translation: The organisers of the festival will keep a copy of the closure notice.

signals.translation: Please check your reservation confirmation upon arrival. When visiting the registry, visitors can record information in handwriting.

passages.english_span: Show the inspection booking confirmation on arrival.
passages.chinese_span: 抵達後請出示查閱預約確認。
passages.translation: Please check your reservation confirmation upon arrival.

passages.english_span: Visitors may take handwritten notes during inspection.
passages.chinese_span: 查閱登記冊時,訪客可用手寫方式記錄資料。
passages.translation: When visiting the registry, visitors can record information in handwriting.

signals.translation: If the supervisor is absent, only students who have not started the examination can apply for the re-examination. The registry records the actual time of each candidate's examination. Submitted questionnaires must be submitted to the Director of Examinations.

passages.english_span: If a supervisor is absent, only candidates whose session could not start may request a retake.
passages.chinese_span: 如監考員缺席,只有未能開始應考的學生可申請重考。
passages.translation: If the supervisor is absent, only students who have not started the examination can apply for the re-examination.

passages.english_span: The register records the actual start of each candidate's session.
passages.chinese_span: 登記冊會記錄每名考生的實際開考時間。
passages.translation: The registry records the actual time of each candidate's examination.

passages.english_span: Any existing scripts must be handed to the exams officer.
passages.chinese_span: 已派出的答題卷須交予考務主任。
passages.translation: Submitted questionnaires must be submitted to the Director of Examinations.

signals.translation: Members of the Society may mark the reproduced photographs for editing. Only after removing the coordinates can investigative photos be placed in the public library. Photos of the species can be seen.

passages.english_span: Club members can flag duplicate images for the editor.
passages.chinese_span: 學會會員可標記重複相片,供編輯處理。
passages.translation: Members of the Society may mark the reproduced photographs for editing.

passages.english_span: Include photographs from the survey in the public gallery only if the coordinates have been removed.
passages.chinese_span: 只有在刪除坐標後,調查相片才可放入公開相簿。
passages.translation: Only after removing the coordinates can investigative photos be placed in the public library.

passages.english_span: The caption may identify the species.
passages.chinese_span: 相片說明可註明物種。
passages.translation: Photos of the species can be seen.

signals.translation: Separate pages of collections of works must be made of uncoated cardboard.

passages.english_span: Use uncoated card for the portfolio divider sheets.
passages.chinese_span: 作品集的分隔頁須用無塗層卡紙。
passages.translation: Separate pages of collections of works must be made of uncoated cardboard.

signals.translation: There is an oral imaging service at the screening site.

passages.english_span: The screening includes audio description.
passages.chinese_span: 放映場次設有口述影像服務。
passages.translation: There is an oral imaging service at the screening site.

signals.translation: Students can preview the facts on the recommendation table, but the teacher's comments are kept confidential. Applications are processed by the Office of Higher Education Counseling. Students must provide their own application number.

passages.english_span: A student may preview the factual information and the teacher's comments on a reference form.
passages.chinese_span: 學生可預覽推薦表上的事實資料,但教師評語仍屬保密。
passages.translation: Students can preview the facts on the recommendation table, but the teacher's comments are kept confidential.

passages.english_span: Requests are handled through the guidance office.
passages.chinese_span: 申請由升學輔導辦事處處理。
passages.translation: Applications are processed by the Office of Higher Education Counseling.

passages.english_span: The student supplies their own application number.
passages.chinese_span: 學生須自行提供申請編號。
passages.translation: Students must provide their own application number.

signals.translation: Each pronunciation practice recording must be included in a collection of individual works. Please wear headphones when listening to recordings in the classroom.

passages.english_span: Save each pronunciation recording in your private portfolio.
passages.chinese_span: 每段發音練習錄音均須存入個人作品集。
passages.translation: Each pronunciation practice recording must be included in a collection of individual works.

passages.english_span: Use headphones when reviewing recordings in class.
passages.chinese_span: 在課堂上重聽錄音時,請戴上耳機。
passages.translation: Please wear headphones when listening to recordings in the classroom.

signals.translation: The road signs were removed by the train operators and the temporary road markings were removed by the transportation team. After arriving at the scene, the supervisor takes pictures of the scene. Please refer to the original chart to verify the arrival and departure arrangements.

passages.english_span: The tram operator removes the diversion signs, and the traffic team removes the temporary road markings.
passages.chinese_span: 改道指示牌由電車營辦商拆除,臨時路面標記則由交通小組清除。
passages.translation: The road signs were removed by the train operators and the temporary road markings were removed by the transportation team.

passages.english_span: A supervisor will photograph the site after reinstatement.
passages.chinese_span: 還原現場後,督導人員會拍攝現場相片。
passages.translation: After arriving at the scene, the supervisor takes pictures of the scene.

passages.english_span: Use the original layout plan to check site access.
passages.chinese_span: 請參照原有平面圖,核對現場出入安排。
passages.translation: Please refer to the original chart to verify the arrival and departure arrangements.

signals.translation: Please specify the expenditure of the project. When applying for a refund, a separate invoice must be submitted.

passages.english_span: State which project the expenditure relates to.
passages.chinese_span: 請說明開支所屬的項目。
passages.translation: Please specify the expenditure of the project.

passages.english_span: Submit the itemised invoice with the reimbursement claim.
passages.chinese_span: 申請發還款項時須提交分項發票。
passages.translation: When applying for a refund, a separate invoice must be submitted.

signals.translation: The map marker may be changed if confirmed by the site manager or one of the original providers. Map editors will check if there are repeat locations.

passages.english_span: We accept a pin change if either the venue manager or the original contributor confirms it.
passages.chinese_span: 地圖標記如獲場地經理或原提供資料者其中一方確認,便可更改。
passages.translation: The map marker may be changed if confirmed by the site manager or one of the original providers.

passages.english_span: The map editor checks for duplicate locations.
passages.chinese_span: 地圖編輯人員會檢查是否有重複地點。
passages.translation: Map editors will check if there are repeat locations.

signals.translation: Before students borrow a photocopy, they must first clear their personal notes on the back. At the end of the event, students can keep the remaining drawings. The exhibition covers different periods of local history.

passages.english_span: If a pupil lends out a photocopy, they must remove any personal notes on its reverse first.
passages.chinese_span: 學生借出影印本前,須先清除背面的個人筆記。
passages.translation: Before students borrow a photocopy, they must first clear their personal notes on the back.

passages.english_span: Pupils may keep the spare sheets after the outing.
passages.chinese_span: 活動結束後學生可保留剩餘的畫紙。
passages.translation: At the end of the event, students can keep the remaining drawings.

passages.english_span: The exhibition covers several periods of local history.
passages.chinese_span: 展覽涵蓋本地歷史的不同時期。
passages.translation: The exhibition covers different periods of local history.

signals.translation: Tire samples can be borrowed free of charge for 10 days. Please note the color number on the sample book.

passages.english_span: The free yarn sample loan lasts ten days.
passages.chinese_span: 紗線樣本可免費借用十天。

signals.translation: Please fill in the batch record sheet for the total number of samples received. signals.translation: Please fix the frame until the pattern is re-printed. When you put a sample in, one side of the ink must be pointed upwards.

passages.english_span: Hold the frame steady until the image transfers.
passages.chinese_span: 請固定框架,直至圖案轉印完成。
passages.translation: Please fix the frame until the pattern is re-printed.

passages.english_span: Insert the artwork with the inked face down.
passages.chinese_span: 放入圖樣時,有油墨的一面須朝上。
passages.translation: When you put a sample in, one side of the ink must be pointed upwards.

signals.translation: Please spray a thin layer of paint solution on the sketch practice. Please do not finish the drawing until the drawing is finished.

passages.english_span: Apply one light coat to the practice sketch.
passages.chinese_span: 請在練習素描上薄噴一層定畫液。
passages.translation: Please spray a thin layer of paint solution on the sketch practice.

passages.english_span: Work with the sketch laid flat.
passages.chinese_span: 請將素描平放後才處理。
passages.translation: Please do not finish the drawing until the drawing is finished.

signals.translation: The name of the speaker is indicated, please refer to the program format instructions. Private contact information must be deleted before the draft can be read for comments. It is possible to add spelling corrections to shared documents.

passages.english_span: Please use the show's style sheet for speaker labels.
passages.chinese_span: 說話者的姓名標示請參照節目格式指引。
passages.translation: The name of the speaker is indicated, please refer to the program format instructions.

passages.english_span: Remove any private contact details from the draft before sending it around for comments.
passages.chinese_span: 傳閱草稿以徵詢意見前,須刪除當中的私人聯絡資料。
passages.translation: Private contact information must be deleted before the draft can be read for comments.

passages.english_span: Spelling corrections can be added in the shared document.
passages.chinese_span: 可在共用文件加入拼寫更正。
passages.translation: It is possible to add spelling corrections to shared documents.

warnings.english_span: Keep the writing folder for one term after the final review.
warnings.chinese_span: 完成最後一次檢視後,請保留寫作資料夾兩個學期。
warnings.machine_backtranslation: After completing the last inspection, please keep the writing material for two semesters.

signals.translation: After completing the last inspection, please keep the writing material for two semesters. This is the first time that a person has written a textbook.

passages.english_span: Keep the writing folder for one term after the final review.
passages.chinese_span: 完成最後一次檢視後,請保留寫作資料夾兩個學期。
passages.translation: After completing the last inspection, please keep the writing material for two semesters.

passages.english_span: The folder may contain handwritten work.
passages.chinese_span: 資料夾可存放手寫習作。
passages.translation: This is the first time that a person has written a textbook.

signals.translation: The order list contains the capacity of each glass bottle. Glass bottles are paid in gold by bank transfer.

passages.english_span: The jar sizes are listed on the order form.
passages.chinese_span: 訂購表列有各款玻璃瓶的容量。
passages.translation: The order list contains the capacity of each glass bottle.

passages.english_span: Pay the jar deposit by bank transfer.
passages.chinese_span: 玻璃瓶按金須以銀行轉帳繳付。
passages.translation: Glass bottles are paid in gold by bank transfer.

signals.translation: Please use a sterile glass bottle with the sample set. Please record the water temperature at the sample point.

passages.english_span: Use the sterile glass bottle supplied with the sampling kit.
passages.chinese_span: 請使用採樣套件隨附的無菌玻璃瓶。
passages.translation: Please use a sterile glass bottle with the sample set.

passages.english_span: Record the water temperature at the sampling point.
passages.chinese_span: 請記錄採樣點的水溫。
passages.translation: Please record the water temperature at the sample point.

signals.translation: The rest of the cooks must be classified in the meeting room. Inside bags must be accompanied by a local certification mark, which can be placed in the compost collection system.

passages.english_span: Food scraps are sorted at the venue.
passages.chinese_span: 廚餘須在會場分類。
passages.translation: The rest of the cooks must be classified in the meeting room.

passages.english_span: Liners can enter the compost collection stream only if they carry the certification mark listed on the site notice.
passages.chinese_span: 內袋須有場地告示所列的認證標誌,方可投放到堆肥收集系統。
passages.translation: Inside bags must be accompanied by a local certification mark, which can be placed in the compost collection system.

signals.translation: Members may practice testing samples with a weaving machine. Tire samples can be borrowed free of charge for 10 days.

passages.english_span: Members can try the samples on the practice loom.
passages.chinese_span: 會員可在練習用織機試用樣本。
passages.translation: Members may practice testing samples with a weaving machine.

passages.english_span: The free yarn sample loan lasts ten days.
passages.chinese_span: 紗線樣本可免費借用十天。
passages.translation: Tire samples can be borrowed free of charge for 10 days.

signals.translation: The attached illustration must be returned to the sender and the attached letter must remain in the project file. The judging panel meets monthly. Each file submitted is assigned a reference number for the coding project.

passages.english_span: Return the supporting illustrations to the sender and retain the covering letter in the project file.
passages.chinese_span: 附交的插圖須退回寄件人,隨附函件則留在項目檔案。
passages.translation: The attached illustration must be returned to the sender and the attached letter must remain in the project file.

passages.english_span: The review panel meets monthly.
passages.chinese_span: 評審小組每月開會。
passages.translation: The judging panel meets monthly.

passages.english_span: Each submission is assigned a project reference.
passages.chinese_span: 每份呈交的文件均獲編配項目參考編號。
passages.translation: Each file submitted is assigned a reference number for the coding project.

signals.translation: After the re-examination of the application is approved, the candidate will receive written confirmation. If the supervisor is absent, only students who have not started the examination can apply for the re-examination. Submitted questionnaires must be submitted to the Director of Examinations.

passages.english_span: A written confirmation will be issued for each approved retake.
passages.chinese_span: 重考申請獲批後,考生會收到書面確認。
passages.translation: After the re-examination of the application is approved, the candidate will receive written confirmation.

passages.english_span: If a supervisor is absent, only candidates whose session could not start may request a retake.
passages.chinese_span: 如監考員缺席,只有未能開始應考的學生可申請重考。
passages.translation: If the supervisor is absent, only students who have not started the examination can apply for the re-examination.

passages.english_span: Any existing scripts must be handed to the exams officer.
passages.chinese_span: 已派出的答題卷須交予考務主任。
passages.translation: Submitted questionnaires must be submitted to the Director of Examinations.

signals.translation: Before the audience enters, the display equipment technicians will check the image signal. The first set up archives to hide speakers' notes, while the second set up speakers' notes to hide speakers' names. The public demonstration must enable a second set-up file; protection measures for the set-up file must be maintained even if the screen has been replaced in the middle.

passages.english_span: The display technician checks the screen feed before people enter.
passages.chinese_span: 觀眾入場前,顯示設備技術員會檢查畫面訊號。
passages.translation: Before the audience enters, the display equipment technicians will check the image signal.

passages.english_span: The first profile hides presenter notes, while the second hides both the notes and local file names.
passages.chinese_span: 第一個設定檔會隱藏講者備註,第二個則同時隱藏講者備註及本機檔案名稱。
passages.translation: The first set up archives to hide speakers' notes, while the second set up speakers' notes to hide speakers' names.

passages.english_span: For a public demonstration, enable the second profile, but retain its protections even if the connected screen is replaced halfway through.
passages.chinese_span: 公開示範須啟用第二個設定檔;即使中途更換已接駁的屏幕,亦須維持該設定檔的保護措施。
passages.translation: The public demonstration must enable a second set-up file; protection measures for the set-up file must be maintained even if the screen has been replaced in the middle.

signals.translation: Members of the Society may mark the reproduced photographs for editing. Only after removing the coordinates can investigative photos be placed in the public library. Photos of the species can be seen.

passages.english_span: Club members can flag duplicate images for the editor.
passages.chinese_span: 學會會員可標記重複相片,供編輯處理。
passages.translation: Members of the Society may mark the reproduced photographs for editing.

passages.english_span: Include photographs from the survey in the public gallery only if the coordinates have been removed.
passages.chinese_span: 只有在刪除坐標後,調查相片才可放入公開相簿。
passages.translation: Only after removing the coordinates can investigative photos be placed in the public library.

passages.english_span: The caption may identify the species.
passages.chinese_span: 相片說明可註明物種。
passages.translation: Photos of the species can be seen.

signals.translation: The scoreboard only shows the scores of the teams ranked in the top four. At the end of each round, scores for the round are entered.

passages.english_span: The scoreboard shows only the scores of the top four houses.
passages.chinese_span: 計分板只顯示排名首四名的社隊分數。
passages.translation: The scoreboard only shows the scores of the teams ranked in the top four.

passages.english_span: Question scores are entered after each round.
passages.chinese_span: 每輪結束後會輸入該輪題目的得分。
passages.translation: At the end of each round, scores for the round are entered.

signals.translation: When you start recording, please read the title of the chapter. Each pronunciation practice recording must be included in a collection of individual works.

passages.english_span: Begin the recording with the title of the passage.
passages.chinese_span: 開始錄音時,請先讀出篇章標題。
passages.translation: When you start recording, please read the title of the chapter.

passages.english_span: Save each pronunciation recording in your private portfolio.
passages.chinese_span: 每段發音練習錄音均須存入個人作品集。
passages.translation: Each pronunciation practice recording must be included in a collection of individual works.

signals.translation: The item list contains individual case numbers. The list of items is signed by the person receiving the relics.

passages.english_span: The inventory carries the case number.
passages.chinese_span: 物品清單載有個案編號。
passages.translation: The item list contains individual case numbers.

passages.english_span: The officer receiving the property signs the inventory.
passages.chinese_span: 物品清單由接收遺物的人員簽署。
passages.translation: The list of items is signed by the person receiving the relics.

signals.translation: Please use dry cotton clean consonant labels.

passages.english_span: Clean the raised labels with a dry cotton cloth.
passages.chinese_span: 請用乾棉布清潔凸字標籤。
passages.translation: Please use dry cotton clean consonant labels.

signals.translation: Applicants are required to submit a brief self-introduction. Alumni instructors match students according to their areas of interest.

passages.english_span: Applicants submit a short introduction.
passages.chinese_span: 申請人須提交簡短自我介紹。
passages.translation: Applicants are required to submit a brief self-introduction.

passages.english_span: Mentors are matched to students by field of interest.
passages.chinese_span: 校友導師與學生按感興趣的領域配對。
passages.translation: Alumni instructors match students according to their areas of interest.

signals.translation: Unapproved substitutes are notified by ballot papers and the team list is corrected by the Secretary of the Games. Please keep the original team list together with the match report.

passages.english_span: The referee flags an unauthorised substitute, and the tournament secretary corrects the team sheet.
passages.chinese_span: 未經批准替補上場的球員由球證提報,隊伍名單則由賽事秘書更正。
passages.translation: Unapproved substitutes are notified by ballot papers and the team list is corrected by the Secretary of the Games.

passages.english_span: Keep the original team sheet with the match report.
passages.chinese_span: 請把原有隊伍名單與比賽報告一併保存。
passages.translation: Please keep the original team list together with the match report.

signals.translation: The opt-out option is for videos only, and text records are still available for viewing. The workshop features videos for students who are unable to attend. Speakers will also share slides.

passages.english_span: An opt-out covers publication of the video, while the written transcript remains available.
passages.chinese_span: 退出發布的選擇只適用於影片,文字記錄仍可供查閱。
passages.translation: The opt-out option is for videos only, and text records are still available for viewing.

passages.english_span: The seminar is recorded for students who miss the live session.
passages.chinese_span: 研討會設錄影,方便未能出席的學生。
passages.translation: The workshop features videos for students who are unable to attend.

passages.english_span: Slides will be shared separately by the presenter.
passages.chinese_span: 講者會另行分享投影片。
passages.translation: Speakers will also share slides.

signals.translation: Unused wires must be returned to the original packaging. Tire samples can be borrowed free of charge for 10 days.

passages.english_span: Return unused strands in the original sleeve.
passages.chinese_span: 未用完的紗線須放回原有封套交還。
passages.translation: Unused wires must be returned to the original packaging.

passages.english_span: The free yarn sample loan lasts ten days.
passages.chinese_span: 紗線樣本可免費借用十天。
passages.translation: Tire samples can be borrowed free of charge for 10 days.

warnings.english_span: The call record distinguishes colour complaints from pressure complaints.
warnings.chinese_span: 來電紀錄會區分水色和水壓投訴。
warnings.machine_backtranslation: The electrical records distinguish between water color and water pressure complaints.

signals.translation: The electricity received during the water pressure disruption must be deferred. Residents should prioritize treatment if they report a change in water color after the water supply is restored. Emergency security assistance is still directed to the response team. The electrical records distinguish between water color and water pressure complaints.

passages.english_span: For calls logged during a pressure outage, defer routine callbacks.
passages.chinese_span: 水壓中斷期間接獲的來電,須暫緩例行回電。
passages.translation: The electricity received during the water pressure disruption must be deferred.

passages.english_span: Give priority instead to those who report discoloured water after supply has resumed.
passages.chinese_span: 住戶如在恢復供水後報稱食水變色,則須優先處理。
passages.translation: Residents should prioritize treatment if they report a change in water color after the water supply is restored.

passages.english_span: Urgent safety calls continue to go straight to the response team.
passages.chinese_span: 緊急安全求助仍直接轉介應變小組。
passages.translation: Emergency security assistance is still directed to the response team.

passages.english_span: The call record distinguishes colour complaints from pressure complaints.
passages.chinese_span: 來電紀錄會區分水色和水壓投訴。
passages.translation: The electrical records distinguish between water color and water pressure complaints.

signals.translation: After each maintenance, the batch number of the lubricant must be recorded. Cleaning materials should be stored in maintenance cabinets.

passages.english_span: Record the lubricant batch number after each maintenance session.
passages.chinese_span: 每次保養後,須記錄潤滑劑的批次編號。
passages.translation: After each maintenance, the batch number of the lubricant must be recorded.

passages.english_span: Keep cleaning materials in the maintenance cupboard.
passages.chinese_span: 清潔物料請存放於保養用品櫃。
passages.translation: Cleaning materials should be stored in maintenance cabinets.

signals.translation: The reception is equipped with clean bags. At the end of the event, the volunteers gathered an empty collection point. Inside bags must be accompanied by a local certification mark, which can be placed in the compost collection system.

passages.english_span: Clean liners are stocked at the reception desk.
passages.chinese_span: 接待處備有清潔的內袋。
passages.translation: The reception is equipped with clean bags.

passages.english_span: Volunteers empty collection points at the end of the event.
passages.chinese_span: 活動完結時由義工清空收集點。
passages.translation: At the end of the event, the volunteers gathered an empty collection point.

passages.english_span: Liners can enter the compost collection stream if they carry any compostability mark.
passages.chinese_span: 內袋須有場地告示所列的認證標誌,方可投放到堆肥收集系統。
passages.translation: Inside bags must be accompanied by a local certification mark, which can be placed in the compost collection system.

signals.translation: The translator may ask to read the wording of the statement first. Translators must be at least 18 years old.

passages.english_span: The interpreter may ask to review the wording of the declaration.
passages.chinese_span: 傳譯員可要求先查閱聲明的措辭。
passages.translation: The translator may ask to read the wording of the statement first.

passages.english_span: The interpreter must be at least 18 years old.
passages.chinese_span: 傳譯員須年滿18歲。
passages.translation: Translators must be at least 18 years old.

signals.translation: The inspectors will call the tenant before entering the house. For the first time, you will need to pay a fee to apply for a checkup.

passages.english_span: The inspection team will phone the tenant before visiting.
passages.chinese_span: 檢查人員上門前會致電租戶。
passages.translation: The inspectors will call the tenant before entering the house.

passages.english_span: There is no fee for requesting an initial drainage inspection.
passages.chinese_span: 首次申請渠務檢查毋須繳費。
passages.translation: For the first time, you will need to pay a fee to apply for a checkup.

signals.translation: This is the first time that a person has written a textbook. After completing the last inspection, please keep the writing material for one semester.

passages.english_span: The folder may contain handwritten work.
passages.chinese_span: 資料夾可存放手寫習作。
passages.translation: This is the first time that a person has written a textbook.

passages.english_span: Keep the writing folder for one term after the final review.
passages.chinese_span: 完成最後一次檢視後,請保留寫作資料夾一個學期。
passages.translation: After completing the last inspection, please keep the writing material for one semester.

signals.translation: If you would like to discuss the work papers, please bring them together. If you are unable to attend your appointment, please notify the Director of Learning Support Planning.

passages.english_span: Bring any worksheets you wish to discuss.
passages.chinese_span: 如有希望討論的工作紙,請一併帶來。
passages.translation: If you would like to discuss the work papers, please bring them together.

passages.english_span: Notify the learning support coordinator if you cannot attend your appointment.
passages.chinese_span: 如未能出席預約時段,請通知學習支援統籌主任。
passages.translation: If you are unable to attend your appointment, please notify the Director of Learning Support Planning.

signals.translation: Please add a label on the outer edge of the separating page. Separate pages of collections of works must be made of uncoated cardboard.

passages.english_span: Label the dividers along the outside edge.
passages.chinese_span: 請在分隔頁的外側邊緣加上標籤。
passages.translation: Please add a label on the outer edge of the separating page.

passages.english_span: Use uncoated card for the portfolio divider sheets.
passages.chinese_span: 作品集的分隔頁須用無塗層卡紙。
passages.translation: Separate pages of collections of works must be made of uncoated cardboard.

signals.translation: The reference number will be sent to the payment service provider via security message. If the food item has been transferred twice, only the first transfer shall be revoked and the second transfer shall not be processed until the payment service provider has responded. The account will show the previous order of each transfer.

passages.english_span: The payment provider receives the reference number by secure message.
passages.chinese_span: 參考編號會以保安訊息發給付款服務商。
passages.translation: The reference number will be sent to the payment service provider via security message.

passages.english_span: If dining credits were moved twice, restore only the first transfer and leave the second transfer untouched until the payment provider responds.
passages.chinese_span: 如膳食積分已轉移兩次,須只撤銷首次轉移,在付款服務商回覆前不得處理第二次轉移。
passages.translation: If the food item has been transferred twice, only the first transfer shall be revoked and the second transfer shall not be processed until the payment service provider has responded.

passages.english_span: The account shows the sequence of transfers.
passages.chinese_span: 帳戶會顯示各次轉移的先後次序。
passages.translation: The account will show the previous order of each transfer.

signals.translation: When the humidity indicator card has a triangle that turns pink, please change the indicator card. Before touching the new instruction card, wash your hands and wipe your hands.

passages.english_span: Replace the humidity card once three squares have turned pink.
passages.chinese_span: 濕度指示卡有三格變成粉紅色時,請更換指示卡。
passages.translation: When the humidity indicator card has a triangle that turns pink, please change the indicator card.

passages.english_span: Wash and dry your hands before handling a new card.
passages.chinese_span: 觸碰新指示卡前,請洗手並把雙手抹乾。
passages.translation: Before touching the new instruction card, wash your hands and wipe your hands.

signals.translation: The scoreboard only shows the scores of the teams ranked in the top four.

passages.english_span: The scoreboard shows only the scores of the top four houses.
passages.chinese_span: 計分板只顯示排名首四名的社隊分數。
passages.translation: The scoreboard only shows the scores of the teams ranked in the top four.

When inspecting a repaired scanner, use the first setup file in the test manual to perform the test scan.

passages.english_span: Delete test scans when the check is complete.
passages.chinese_span: 完成檢查後須刪除測試掃描檔案。
passages.translation: After completion of the inspection, the test scan file must be deleted.

passages.english_span: The first profile captures both sides, and the second captures only the front.
passages.chinese_span: 第一個設定檔掃描正反兩面,第二個則只掃描正面。
passages.translation: The first set of file scans are on opposite sides, while the second only scans on the positive side.

passages.english_span: When checking the repaired scanner, use the second profile in the test guide for the test scan.
passages.chinese_span: 檢查已維修的掃描器時,請採用測試指引所載的第一個設定檔進行測試掃描。
passages.translation: When inspecting a repaired scanner, use the first setup file in the test manual to perform the test scan.

signals.translation: Please record the time of the first discovery of the oil membrane. Please describe the appearance of the oil film in the accident record.

passages.english_span: Record the time when the oil sheen was first seen.
passages.chinese_span: 請記錄首次發現油膜的時間。
passages.translation: Please record the time of the first discovery of the oil membrane.

passages.english_span: Describe the appearance of the sheen in the incident log.
passages.chinese_span: 請在事故紀錄內描述油膜的外觀。
passages.translation: Please describe the appearance of the oil film in the accident record.

signals.translation: Please save the changed voucher number yourself. Blue vouchers can be used for clothing at a later exchange event, and yellow vouchers can be used as a down payment for the following year's event. passages.english_span: A cancelled collection retains the option printed on the blue voucher, unless the replacement voucher has already been redeemed.
passages.chinese_span: 取消領取後,仍可使用藍色券所列的選項,但如補發券已獲兌換,則不在此限。

passages.translation: The story-sharing group retains the recording for internal editing only and shares edited texts with the group members.

passages.english_span: Speakers may suggest amendments to the edited text.
passages.chinese_span: 講述者可就文字稿提出修訂建議。
passages.translation: The speaker may make suggestions for revising the text.

signals.translation: When the handle is tuned to the lowest position, it is locked. The driver's handle can be lowered by pressing the lock button inwards.

passages.english_span: The handle locks into place at its lowest setting.
passages.chinese_span: 手柄調至最低位置時會鎖定。
passages.translation: When the handle is tuned to the lowest position, it is locked.

passages.english_span: Push the latch inward to lower the trolley handle.
passages.chinese_span: 向內按下鎖扣即可放低手推車手柄。
passages.translation: The driver's handle can be lowered by pressing the lock button inwards.
